description: Independently checked practice answers. Not an official UPSC answer key. Source options visually checked on the original Series A pages.

questions.explanation: A pontoon can support a temporary floating bridge; a platoon is a military unit made up of soldiers.
To invoke a law is to call on it for use. To revoke permission or an agreement is to cancel it officially.
Imminent describes something about to happen. Eminent describes a distinguished or highly respected person.
Liable means legally responsible. Libel refers to a false published statement that damages someone's reputation.
Incredible means difficult to believe; incredulous describes someone who is unwilling or unable to believe something.
Climatic relates to climate. Climactic relates to the climax, or most intense part, of a story or event.
A cursor is an on-screen pointer. A cursory action is quick and superficial rather than careful or thorough.
Affect commonly means to influence, whereas effect commonly names the result or consequence of an action.
Hard can mean difficult or demanding. Hardly means scarcely or almost not; it does not mean very hard.
Conscious means aware or able to perceive. Conscience is the inner moral sense of right and wrong.
An iconoclast challenges established beliefs or traditions; the term is not simply a critic of a celebrity.
An axiom is a statement or principle accepted as true without requiring proof within the system being used.
A holistic approach considers the complete system and the relationships between its parts, not isolated parts alone.
Obsequious describes someone excessively eager to please, serve or obey, especially a person with authority.
Pachyderm traditionally describes a thick-skinned mammal, such as an elephant, rhinoceros or hippopotamus.
Ubiquitous means present or found everywhere, so wide presence is the best of these options.
To desiccate is to remove moisture or dry something thoroughly; chopping and slicing do not imply drying.
Deleterious means harmful or damaging. It is not the process of deleting something.
To equivocate is to avoid a clear commitment by using ambiguous or evasive language, often concealing the truth.
Indolent means lazy or disinclined to exert effort. It does not mean generous, indulgent or poor.
Mealy-mouthed describes a person who avoids speaking plainly or directly, especially through fear or excessive caution.
To live in each other's pockets means to spend an excessive amount of time together, not to share money.
To play possum means to pretend to be dead or inactive, drawing on the defensive behaviour of an opossum.
To work like a dog means to work very hard; the expression emphasises effort rather than loyalty or reward.
Opening a can of worms means creating or uncovering a complicated situation with many troublesome problems.
More than meets the eye means that something has hidden significance or complexity beyond what is immediately apparent.
To hold the fort means to take responsibility and keep things running while the usual person is absent.
It's all Greek to me means that the speaker cannot understand something at all, not merely that it is foreign.
To close ranks means to unite and support each other against criticism or opposition in defence of a shared interest.
To be under a cloud means to be viewed with suspicion or disapproval; it does not simply mean being unhappy.
